theorem_contract.fixed_atlas: J_T={j:T/a_j integer}; empty for |J_T|<2, the corresponding circle for |J_T|=2, and the whole link for |J_T|=3; every nonempty component is Morse-Bott
theorem_contract.indices: mu_CZ(gamma^r)=2*floor(r*rho)+1 before first degeneracy; principal mu_RS=-2*p*q+4*p+4*q
theorem_contract.periods: principal period 2*p*q; exceptional periods 2*p, 2*q, and p*q
theorem_contract.quotient: the orbit quotient is the Seifert orbifold S2(2,p,q) with chi_orb=1/2+1/p+1/q-1
theorem_contract.rotations: rho_01=2*p/q, rho_02=2*q/p, rho_12=p*q/2 in the declared trivializations; first degeneracy at q, p, and 2 covers
theorem_contract.sign: chi_orb and mu_RS are positive only for (p,q)=(3,5), negative otherwise, and never zero
